# Kata Agent Team

> An agent team that improves itself on a daily Plan-Do-Study-Act cycle.
<!-- enum:published-skills:count -->
> It ships nineteen skills in plain JavaScript,
<!-- /enum -->
> and you maintain no infrastructure.

Kata is an open-source agent team for coding repositories. Eight agent
personas run the daily Plan-Do-Study-Act cycle: Staff Engineer, Release
Engineer, Security Engineer, DevEx Engineer, Product Manager, Technical
Writer, Archivist, and Improvement Coach.
<!-- enum:published-skills:count -->
Nineteen skills do the team's work.
<!-- /enum -->
The team runs on plain JavaScript. It needs no database, no queue, and no
third-party dependency. Shared state is a set of markdown files in a Git
repository.

Install the pack with `apm install forwardimpact/kata-skills`, then ask
Claude to set up the team.

The documentation covers three areas. Getting Started takes a repository with
no automation to one completed shift. Run a Continuously Improving Agent Team
covers the daily loop: the agent roster, the line between memory and
coordination, the storyboard and coaching session, and the route for every
Study finding. Take a Change from Spec to Shipped covers the spec, design,
plan, implement, review, merge, and release sequence, together with the
approval gates and the trust boundary. Kata runs on the Gemba platform at
https://www.gemba.team/, follows the Jidoka instruction architecture at
https://www.jidoka.team/, and uses the repository structure at
https://www.monorepo.team/.
